subject: Chase — submission of 3 September 2026: Great House Farm / suspected historic fraud
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Victim Liaison Cymru

I wrote on 3 September 2026 (subject: Re-Opening of BP vs Buckler 1987)
placing before CPS Cymru material concerning suspected historic fraud and
related conduct arising from the registration and later dispossession at
Great House Farm, Llandough.

I have had no acknowledgement.

Please confirm:
1. that the 3 September submission was received;
2. the reference number allocated; and
3. whether CPS Cymru will consider the material, or whether I should
instead report to Action Fraud / South Wales Police for a crime reference
number.

Regards,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
greathousefarmwiki.wordpress.com
